request.sql: SELECT a.belong_base, p.category AS sub_category, a.stat_month, SUM(a.source_rows) AS source_rows, SUM(a.missing_qty) AS missing_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN a.quantity_variants > 1 THEN a.source_rows ELSE 0 END) AS duplicate_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN a.quantity_variants = 1 AND a.missing_qty = 0 THEN a.raw_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS demand_qty, MAX(a.update_time) AS update_time FROM (SELECT belong_base, material_code, stat_month, SUM(source_rows) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) AS quantity_variants, SUM(CASE WHEN demand_qty IS NULL THEN source_rows ELSE 0 END) AS missing_qty, SUM(demand_qty) AS raw_quantity, MAX(update_time) AS update_time FROM (SELECT belong_base, TRIM(material_code) AS material_code, stat_month, demand_qty, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, MAX(update_time) AS update_time FROM agents_dim_demand_annual_mi WHERE material_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(material_code) <> '' GROUP BY belong_base, TRIM(material_code), stat_month, demand_qty) AS source_values GROUP BY belong_base, material_code, stat_month) AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT TRIM(material_code) AS material_code, MIN(TRIM(sub_category)) AS category FROM agents_dim_product_list_mi WHERE material_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(material_code) <> '' GROUP BY TRIM(material_code) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(sub_category)) = 1 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN sub_category IS NULL OR TRIM(sub_category) = '' THEN 1 END) = 0) AS p ON a.material_code = p.material_code GROUP BY a.belong_base, p.category, a.stat_month ORDER BY belong_base, sub_category, stat_month LIMIT :gea_p98 OFFSET :gea_p99

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM (SELECT a.belong_base, p.category AS sub_category, a.stat_month, SUM(a.source_rows) AS source_rows, SUM(a.missing_qty) AS missing_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN a.quantity_variants > 1 THEN a.source_rows ELSE 0 END) AS duplicate_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN a.quantity_variants = 1 AND a.missing_qty = 0 THEN a.raw_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS demand_qty, MAX(a.update_time) AS update_time FROM (SELECT belong_base, material_code, stat_month, SUM(source_rows) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) AS quantity_variants, SUM(CASE WHEN demand_qty IS NULL THEN source_rows ELSE 0 END) AS missing_qty, SUM(demand_qty) AS raw_quantity, MAX(update_time) AS update_time FROM (SELECT belong_base, TRIM(material_code) AS material_code, stat_month, demand_qty, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, MAX(update_time) AS update_time FROM agents_dim_demand_annual_mi WHERE material_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(material_code) <> '' GROUP BY belong_base, TRIM(material_code), stat_month, demand_qty) AS source_values GROUP BY belong_base, material_code, stat_month) AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT TRIM(material_code) AS material_code, MIN(TRIM(sub_category)) AS category FROM agents_dim_product_list_mi WHERE material_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(material_code) <> '' GROUP BY TRIM(material_code) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(sub_category)) = 1 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN sub_category IS NULL OR TRIM(sub_category) = '' THEN 1 END) = 0) AS p ON a.material_code = p.material_code GROUP BY a.belong_base, p.category, a.stat_month) AS mps_rows
